name: data-quality-watchdog
description: Every night, looks for duplicate customers and products, links to records that no longer exist and malformed emails or SKUs, and proposes merges and fixes for you to approve.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every day at 6:00 in your time zone

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Duplicate customers and products, broken references, malformed emails, SKUs and phone numbers

howItWorks.label: Proposes
howItWorks.text: A merge or a fix for each problem, in one review

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: Before anything is merged or changed; rejected fixes are not proposed again

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short summary to Slack, if you pick a channel

plugins.reason: Posts what was found and what waits for review to a channel

data.description: Customer emails, to find duplicate customers and malformed addresses
Customer names and phones, to confirm a duplicate
Product or variant SKUs, to find duplicates and malformed SKUs
Product names, to confirm a duplicate
Links between records (order to customer, line to product, product to category) to check for broken references
A field that hides a record without deleting it, used for the duplicate left after a merge

parameters.label: SKU format
parameters.description: Your SKU format, e.g. "two to four letters, a dash, then letters and digits"; leave empty to only check for spaces and duplicates

parameters.label: Most fixes per run
parameters.description: The rest wait for the next run, most serious first

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; without it the summary stays in the run notification
